source_proof.scope: Proofs bind runtime hashes and measured proxy slots to the reconstructed header. Consensus/finality, supplied-anchor authenticity, beacon call results, routing semantics and contract safety are not verified.

code_identity.scope: Raw state/header/runtime proofs at one historical block, joined to locally constant decoded call operands. Root target bytes are identified, not replaced by candidate proxy implementation bytes. Source-path and beacon accounts may satisfy matching operands. Missing proofs remain explicit; unresolved calls and metadata findings remain included. No recursive dependency scan, execution, ABI/source equivalence, current code, consensus, finality, anchor authenticity, safety or permission to transact is established.

gas_cap_rehearsal.limits: Matched means only that two provider-reported historical eth_call results equal explicit expected bytes, one with provider-default gas and one with the exact declared gas allowance. This is not gas consumed, an estimate, a minimum gas search, a safe transaction gas limit, authorization or approval. A call may inspect gasleft() and change behavior with its allowance. RPC errors do not establish out-of-gas. No current state, side effects, future execution, ABI correctness or chain/provider authenticity is established. The sender may be a contract, not an available transaction origin. Nothing sent.
gas_cap_rehearsal.reason: both calls returned the exact expected bytes

limits: A historical evidence join only. State proofs bind code to the supplied header, whose consensus authenticity is unverified. Call results remain provider claims, not execution proofs. No code semantics, consumed gas, safe transaction gas limit, authority, future execution or trade bounds are established. Missing constant target proofs and unresolved call operands remain visible. Nothing is signed or sent.
